name: ollama
manual_instructions: For local-model inference, Ollama's FAQ says prompts and responses are not sent back to ollama.com. Cloud models are a separate remote-inference path. Do not invent OLLAMA_TELEMETRY or claim no network traffic: model pulls, application updates, cloud inference and web search can still use the network.

Optional local-only mode removes access to Ollama cloud models AND web search. Present that trade-off and obtain explicit agreement before suggesting a change. The official setting is {"disable_ollama_cloud": true} in the SERVER's ~/.ollama/server.json, preserving existing JSON keys. This is a feature restriction, not a telemetry toggle.

First resolve which server the CLI uses, including any OLLAMA_HOST override. For a server you own and launch interactively, ~/.ollama is relative to that server user's home. For Linux systemd, inspect `systemctl cat ollama.service` and `systemctl show ollama.service --property=User --property=Environment`; service User/HOME and drop-ins can differ from your terminal. Do not create the caller's ~/.ollama/server.json and claim it changed a service or remote server. If the effective server home/owner cannot be established, leave the configuration unchanged and provide the manual instructions to its administrator.

The documented alternative is OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 in the Ollama SERVER environment. After the same explicit trade-off agreement, use the vendor's platform-specific environment instructions: launchctl setenv for the macOS app, a systemctl edit ollama.service [Service] Environment="OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1" override for Linux systemd, or Windows user environment variables for the Windows app. Exporting it only in a CLI client's shell does not update an existing app/service server.

Restart the actual Ollama server after either change. On Linux systemd, the official environment procedure includes daemon-reload and service restart; administrator approval is required. Verify that the restarted server's logs say `Ollama cloud disabled: true`. Until the effective server and this log are verified, report local-only mode as unverified. Existing model files, conversation history and credentials are reported, never deleted.

commands.win32: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'try { $running = Get-Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match "^(ollama|ollama app)$" }; if ($running) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 2 }'

process_check.if_running: The running Ollama server keeps its existing configuration until restarted. Resolve its owner/home and obtain agreement to losing cloud models/web search before changing or restarting it; a CLI-client restart is insufficient.

persistent_files.note: Documented server configuration only when this is the actual server user's home; resolve systemd/remote ownership first. Report only.
User CLI conversation/input history; report only and never delete.
Private account key; report path/permissions only, never print contents or delete.
Public key associated with account access. Report only.

notes: The account/key/history paths belong to the invoking user's default home; they are not evidence of where a system-wide Ollama server reads its configuration.
Local-only mode blocks the documented cloud features but is not an offline/network kill switch. It does not claim to prevent registry downloads, desktop update checks or unrelated clients' traffic.
If OLLAMA_HOST targets an administrator-managed or remote server, provide instructions to that owner and leave local server settings unchanged.

caveats.framing: Optional feature restriction: OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 disables Ollama cloud models and web search. Apply only with explicit agreement, in the actual server's environment, followed by its restart and cloud-disabled log verification. An export in an unrelated CLI-client shell does not change a running server.
